parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no structural evidence to act on: all quantitative fields (differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count) are null, and the members array is empty. The two participating types — StitchableWallpaperView (a renderer) and AccentColorControls (a debug-UI control) — occupy unrelated domain roles within the Wallpaper package, so any apparent subset relationship is structural coincidence rather than a refactorable overlap. Without field lists, a Jaccard score, or a shared ancestor, there is no grounded basis for recommending extraction, protocol inheritance, or any other transformation.
